evidence.claim: Bertolotto Porte dal 1987 progetta e produce porte per interni e porte blindate nello stabilimento di Torre San Giorgio.
evidence.quote: Bertolotto Porte is an all-Italian company founded in 1987, today one of the world leaders in the design and production of doors and systems for interiors and armored doors. || The company moves its plants to Torre San Giorgio. In just 6 years, the production / office area will cover 30,000 square meters.
